tuple.tools: same local shell/file access; no network requirement; disposable projects
tuple.session: --ephemeral; unique disposable CODEX_HOME with only copied auth; native memory import disabled; no previous thread

package.released_v14: 1.4.0 installed artifact; hash recorded at run setup

claim_boundary: Engineering pilot only; no superiority, noninferiority, efficiency, or memory-effect claim. Human blinded judge unavailable. Native server-side memories remain an isolation uncertainty even with disposable local profile.
attempt_policy: Keep every first attempt, invalid request, repair, timeout, failure, retrieval and tool call; null usage is missing, not zero.
